description: This file contains an abstract test runner class 'TransactionAttributionTestRunner' for Orleans transaction attribution, including multiple test methods to validate transaction behaviors and attributes in different contexts.

classes.name: TransactionAttributionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for testing transaction attribution in Orleans, including a series of async test methods for different transaction scenarios.

methods.name: AllSupportedAttributesFromOutsideTransactionTest
methods.description: Tests transaction attributes from a non-transactional call context, verifying transaction ID behaviors for each attribute.

methods.name: AllSupportedAttributesFromWithinTransactionTest
methods.description: Tests transaction attributes within an active transaction, ensuring transaction ID propagation behaviors.

methods.name: CreateOrJoinTest
methods.description: Validates transaction ID behaviors when using CreateOrJoin options, checking for reuse or creation of transaction IDs.

methods.name: CreateTest
methods.description: Tests creation of new transactions, ensuring new transaction IDs differ from parent IDs.

methods.name: SupportedTest
methods.description: Verifies that calls with 'Supported' attributes join parent transactions where appropriate.

methods.name: JoinFailTest
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to join a transaction with 'Join' option fails as expected.

methods.name: NotAllowedFailTest
methods.description: Verifies that attempts to use 'NotAllowed' attribute correctly throw exceptions.
